plainText:
Stuart Zagnit is an American actor and voice actor who worked on the English-language dub of . He is sometimes credited as Stan Hart.

==Pokémon roles==
Zagnit was with since the first episode, making him one of its original voice actors. He stayed on the show until 4Kids stopped dubbing the series. He returned in the , starting with Evolution Exchange Excitement!, where he voiced Cedric Juniper, Professor Juniper's father.
